description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and documentation related to handling packed references (packed-refs) in a Git repository backend. It includes functions for initializing, locking, unlocking, checking lock status, obtaining size, and determining if a transaction is needed for packed refs.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes a packed reference store for a given repository and directory with specified flags.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing, returning 0 on success or an error code.

methods.name: packed_refs_unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the packed-refs file.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the packed-refs file, or 0 if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines if a given reference transaction needs to be applied to the specified packed ref store.
